Good to know

Your Haulfolio
questions, answered.

Does Haulfolio automatically manage my eBay shop?

No. Optional eBay connections let you review and import your own listings and sales. Haulfolio does not publish or edit listings or continuously sync your account.

Do I need Pro to try Haulfolio?

The current Google Play version includes every tool with up to seven owned unsold inventory units. Pro adds unlimited inventory. Check the app for current options and local pricing.

How do I get help with Haulfolio?

Email info@digitalsprout.org with your device, app version and a description of the issue. You can also visit our support page.
